page_title: FIO 0-1 INT | Fiorentina v Inter 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' A lofted cross from Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+4' Rolando Mandragora bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
90+4' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+1' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is given a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Rolando Mandragora plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
90' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) prepares to take a corner kick.
89' Substitution. Fabiano Parisi is replaced by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina).
88' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) is caught offside!

87' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
85' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
83' Substitution. Alfred Duncan makes his way off the pitch and Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes on as his replacement.
83' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Lucas Beltran is replaced by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina).
83' Here's the change. Benjamin Pavard leaves the pitch and Yann Bisseck (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
82' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' An accurate cross finds its way to Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) who sends in a bullet header towards the top of the net from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
82' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
81' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) trips an opposition player and Gianluca Aureliano signals a foul. Fiorentina have been awarded a free kick.
79' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
78' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
77' Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
77' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Yann Sommer who easily stops the effort.
76' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
75' Yann Sommer (Inter) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
75' It’s a PENALTY to Fiorentina after the VAR review!
74' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Fiorentina! Let's see what he decides.

74' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) quickly gets to a rebound somewhere around the penalty spot and attempts a header. His effort might have ended up in the net, but one of the defenders was well positioned on the goal line and knocked the ball away.
74' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
72' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender.

69' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
68' The ball is crossed into the box and M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer gets a glove on it to thwart him.
66' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
64' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Marko Arnautovic (Inter) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
62' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Marko Arnautovic picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) replaces Jonathan Ikone.
60' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcus Thuram.
60' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Francesco Acerbi (Inter) replaces Alessandro Bastoni.
60' Matteo Darmian comes off the pitch to be replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
60' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
58' Matteo Darmian plays a pass into the path of Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
57' The resulting corner, taken by Kristjan Asllani (Inter), comes to nothing.

56' Matteo Darmian (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
55' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post.

54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
53' Yann Sommer leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina).
53' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Half-chance! Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) plays a pass into the box, but Pietro Terracciano reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
49' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Inter win a corner.
48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Inter will take a corner kick.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Maxime Lopez comes on the pitch for Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Gianluca Aureliano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45+2' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+2' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+1' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
45+1' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) as his effort only hit the wall.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
43' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) fails to send in a decent cross from the free kick from the edge of the box. His effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was quite harsh and Gianluca Aureliano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

40' Carlos Augusto (Inter) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
36' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Fiorentina! Play can continue.

36' There's a break in play and referee Gianluca Aureliano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Fiorentina using VAR. This could be interesting!
35' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Fiorentina for a penalty. Play continues.
35' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

34' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Now Fiorentina have a corner.
33' Davide Frattesi (Inter) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
32' Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
31' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

29' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass. Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
28' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle after Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
26' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Thuram (Inter).
25' Total attempts – 2:2. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
21' Fiorentina are seeing far more of the ball now.
18' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
17' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Gianluca Aureliano signals that there was no infringement and the goal stands! The Inter players celebrate.
16' Wait! Referee Gianluca Aureliano has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
14' 0 - 1 Kristjan Asllani sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who outjumps the defence to finish into the top left corner with a header. The score is 0:1.
14' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
14' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a low pass from outside the box to Carlos Augusto. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
11' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
10' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Pietro Terracciano makes a great save to deny his effort directed under the crossbar.
6' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
1' Flag up against M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Inter will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano will supervise the game today.
